$comment: One-off shared costs. Hotel nights are NOT listed here — those are derived
automatically from data/stays.json so a booking is only ever entered once.
paidBy   : person id who actually paid
shares  -> weights in `splitValues` keyed by person id
exact   -> absolute amounts in `splitValues`, must total `amount`
participants defaults to everyone when omitted.
category : lodging | food | transport | luggage | gear | fees | other

expenses.note: €5 per person return. Bought at the machine the evening before.
Roughly $200 per bag. Two big bags shared by the group rather than one each.
